newsitem.title: FRANCE: EU sets 15 Ecus/T tax on daily soft wheat exports.
newsitem.headline: EU sets 15 Ecus/T tax on daily soft wheat exports.

text.p: The European Union on Thursday decided that a tax of 15 Ecus per tonne would apply to daily exports of soft wheat grain, France's grain office ONIC said.
A tax of 20 Ecus per tonne is to apply to daily soft wheat flour exports, it said.

The taxes will become effective as soon as the relevant EU regulation is published in the official journal. In the meantime a nil value refund will continue to apply to soft wheat grain and soft wheat flour exports.
The EU also decided that a tax of 10 Ecus per tonne would apply to daily exports of durum wheat, ONIC said.
A tax of 20 Ecus per tonne will apply to durum wheat semolina exports, it said.
The taxes will replace the current nil value refunds that applied to durum wheat and durum wheat semolina as soon as the EU regulation is published.

ONIC said the EU would refuse all bids to export soft wheat grain, soft wheat flour, durum wheat and durum wheat semolina with nil value refunds ahead of the publication of the new EU rules. But the EU kept at zero the refund available on daily exports of barley.

The EU also maintained at 10 Ecus per tonne the refund on daily maize exports to Switzerland and Liechtenstein. It also kept at 25 Ecus per tonne the refund for daily maize exports to Slovenia, Slovakia, the Czech Republic and Poland.
